mathematical_definition: Fits ACF(lag) ~ exp(-k*lag) via a log-linear regression of log(ACF) on lag across lags [1,2,3,5,10] of ret1, computed over a trailing 240-bar window (numba kernel autocorr_decay_rate) -- the decay RATE k, distinct from any single-lag ACF value computed elsewhere. Note: despite the '_60' suffix in the feature name (inherited unchanged from research/features_v3.py), the actual window argument passed at the call site is 240, not 60
numerical_stability_notes: 0.0 when the window's own autocorrelation-at-lag-0 denominator r0<1e-15 (degenerate) or fewer than 2 valid positive-ACF lags are found for the regression, never a raw division by zero
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first window+max(lags)=250 bars, never zero-filled otherwise
